name: probe-research
description: Probe Research tracking for Kimi Code: the probe switch (on / read / off per conversation), track-work, instrument-code, visualize-progress, edit-notes and audit-team-note skills, plus a read-only OAuth MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Track and query agentic research runs

hooks.command: /bin/bash -c 'ROOT="${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; unset PLUGIN_ROOT CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; export PROBE_AGENT=kimi_code; [ -f "$ROOT/hooks/tracking_guard.py" ] || exit 0; PY="$(command -v python3)" || exit 0; exec "$PY" "$ROOT/hooks/harness_io.py" tracking_guard.py'
